item.title: Park City Fashion Week returns, highlighting designers and artists - Park Record
item.description: High-fashion runway production returns to Park City on Sunday, Jan. 25, as Park City Fashion Week takes over the Marquee, spotlighting local talent alongside established designers from across the country.

item.title: More Dogs on Main: Bring on the Sundance blizzard - Park Record
item.description: "It’s kind of a nice Hollywood ending that Sundance, in its final year in Park City, will once again be a significant economic lifeline in an otherwise challenging year. The Sundance crowd may keep some local businesses alive."

item.title: Sundance short film ‘Taga’ creates horror from the search for belonging - Park Record
item.description: "Taga" translates to “from” as well as “to stab” in Tagalog, which is a fitting moniker for a horror film about cultural belonging.

item.title: Sundance short film ‘Busy Bodies’ makes a Rube Goldberg machine of mass production - Park Record
item.description: The image of a sad tuna wrap was the impetus for hundreds of hours animating “Busy Bodies,” which is premiering at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival.
